title: Accessibility overhaul for interactive cards: focus, ARIA roles, and contrast (VPAT prep)
creator: Maya Chen
description:
Background: During the VPAT readiness audit (link below) the interactive card family (dashboard cards, recommendation tiles, billing/product cards) surfaced multiple accessibility issues: missing keyboard access to inner actionable regions, inconsistent ARIA roles/attributes across teams, non‑compliant focus indicators that fail contrast checks, and decorative icons that are announced by screen readers. This ticket coordinates a design-system‑level remediation so teams can adopt a consistent, VPAT-friendly card pattern.

Scope: Apply token, markup, and behavior updates to the core Card component and documented variants (card, list-card, media-card) so they: 1) are fully keyboard operable; 2) expose correct semantic roles and labeling for screen readers; 3) use accessible focus indicators; 4) meet WCAG 2.1 AA contrast targets for text and controls; 5) provide migration guidance for product teams.

Acceptance criteria (done when):
- Core Card and variants have a documented recommended markup pattern (link to spec) showing the preferred DOM structure (single primary action element vs whole-card button depending on use).
- Keyboard behavior: Tab order lands on logical interactive controls; hitting Enter/Space activates expected control; nested links inside cards do not create trapped focus states.
- ARIA: Decorative icons use aria-hidden and aria-hidden="true" applied consistently; complex controls include aria-labelledby or aria-describedby where needed; role attributes (role="button") only used when element is non-semantic and accompanied by keyboard handlers.
- Focus indicator: Updated focus token (ds-focus-ring-strong) applied to Card interactive surfaces, visible at 3:1 contrast against adjacent UI and not solely relying on outline-offset that clips at container edges.
- Color contrast: Text and interactive label contrast meets WCAG 2.1 AA (small text >= 4.5:1, large text >= 3:1); where brand constraints block changes, provide alt token pairings and annotate deviation in VPAT notes.
- Tests: Axe unit checks added to Card stories; visual regression snapshots for focus states; one end-to-end keyboard navigation test in Playwright.
- Documentation: Storybook examples for keyboard interactions and a migration guide with code samples for teams.
- VPAT: Update VPAT matrix entries for Card family to reflect changes and note any residual exceptions with compensating controls.

Design decisions & trade-offs:
- Whole-card buttons vs. discrete actions: We will default Card to a semantic button (or anchor) for single-primary-action use cases. For multi-action cards we recommend non-interactive containers with discrete interactive controls inside. This avoids nested interactive elements and simplifies keyboard semantics.
- Focus token intensity: We evaluated subtle and strong focus treatments. Chosen a moderately prominent focus ring (ds-focus-ring-strong) to satisfy low-vision needs; downside is slight visual weight increase. We will provide a softened token for high-density table/list contexts where visual noise is a concern.
- Color changes vs. tokens: Where contrast fixes required color shifts, prefer creating alternate tokens (e.g., token.card.label-on-surface-high) to limit global brand changes and allow product teams to opt into updated token sets.

Implementation plan:
1) Design spec + updated tokens (this ticket) — deliverables: token names, color swatches, focus styles, markup guidelines.
2) Engineering changes in design-system repo (PR #1240) — aria attribute updates, focus handling, tests.
3) Storybook and docs updates — examples and migration guide.
4) Outreach: notify product owners of breaking changes and provide code snippets for patching existing card usage.
5) VPAT update: record changes and exceptions for final compliance sign-off.

Links & artifacts: 
- Accessibility audit (Confluence): https://confluence.redwood.com/display/DS/Interactive+Card+Accessibility+Audit
- Draft design spec (Drive): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1CardA11ySpecDraft
- Design system PR (engineering): https://github.com/redwood-inference/design-system/pull/1240
- VPAT draft matrix: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1VPAT-Interactive-Cards-DRAFT
- Storybook preview (WIP): https://storybook.redwood-inference.com/?path=/story/components-card--interactive

Notes for eng: avoid using role="button" on divs without documented keyboard handlers; prefer native elements for semantics where possible. Use focus-visible polyfill only if cross-browser gaps remain.
